narrative:
Jackson County has 19,839 registered voters, with 15.8% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.8% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 46.1%, a clear Democratic lean of 11.3 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.4% of registrants.
